title: PLANT says unauthorized access to its e-money contractor's server leaked 42,107 PLANT Pay records
date_note: The articles say the contractor found the anomalies and reported to PLANT on 20 November; the access ran from late 19 November to early 20 November.
geo_basis: Headquarters in Sakai, Fukui Prefecture, as stated by Fukui Shimbun
summary: PLANT, a Fukui-based company, said a third party accessed without authorization the server of a contractor that operates its PLANT Pay e-money service. According to PLANT, 42,107 records were leaked, including card numbers and PIN numbers. PLANT says account passwords were not leaked and, as of 24 November, no fraudulent use had been confirmed.
plain: A contractor's server for the PLANT Pay e-money service was accessed without authorization. PLANT says 42,107 records leaked, including card and PIN numbers, and has not confirmed any misuse as of 24 November.
exec: A supplier's server breach exposed 42,107 e-money records, including card and PIN numbers, according to PLANT.
action: PLANT advises customers to be wary of suspicious emails, SMS or calls impersonating PLANT, and says card number and PIN can be reissued on request.

evidence.quote: PLANTは運用委託先のサーバーが不正アクセスを受け、4万2,107件の個人情報が漏洩

validation.note: Fukui Shimbun and Cybersecurity.com (Japan) each report PLANT's statement; PLANT's own notice PDF could not be read as text and the TDnet PDF returned 403.
